$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -94.024 + 0.636 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.599 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 29.925 \text{T}^{-1} + 17.886 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
